title: Preservation of symbols under selected heads
statement: Let $m\leq k$, let $S$ and $B$ be symbol sets, let $\iota:S\to B$, and let $c$ be a configuration of an $m$-tape machine on input $x$. For every $b\in B$, changing the embedded configuration's state to $b$ leaves unchanged, on each of the first $m$ tapes, the symbol under the head; these symbols agree with those under the heads in $c$.
